pages.title: A Pocket Workshop
pages.text: Finish one native smelting, blasting or smoking recipe in a backpack upgrade.

pages.title: A Pocket Workshop
pages.text: Process materials while traveling; the Stonecutter tab opens precise building-part cutting and sheets support new equipment.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose the appropriate furnace tab and supply fuel. Auto versions pull/push according to settings. Stonecutter, anvil and smithing tabs keep their own recipes and costs rather than acting as universal processing.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Smelting takes a valid furnace recipe and fuel; Auto Smelting separately configures input/output movement.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Blasting handles valid blast-furnace recipes rather than every furnace input; Auto Blasting adds automatic input/output.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Smoking uses valid smoker recipes; Auto Smoking automates movement while retaining native fuel/time rules.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Stonecutter tab selects a permitted result from real input material and commits it on extraction; it is not smelting.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Anvil tab performs compatible combine/repair/rename with real operation cost; upgrade ownership alone is insufficient.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Smithing tab follows installed recipes with required template/materials; it does not create free netherite gear.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Storage Smelting/Smoking/Blasting use their proper recipes/fuel; auto versions move items according to this storage settings.
